data.reportedMetricsNote: The platform's model-level metrics, passed through verbatim; the API does not say which evaluation produced them. On Platform-trained runs observed live they match the post-training evaluation of the best checkpoint, not the last training epoch. On uploaded models they can match the last recorded epoch.

history.note: Records are returned in API order. In observed Platform-trained histories this follows timestamp order, but epoch values are not guaranteed to be ordered, unique, or contiguous. A record may be a post-training evaluation rather than a training epoch; the API does not mark which. Uploaded/backfilled histories may lack timestamps.
